entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Another hold. I just want to return this piece of junk!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return this jersey I bought. The sizing is a complete joke.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the fit. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number?
It's V-F-5-8-2-2-9. And hurry up, I don't have all day. This whole experience has been a nightmare.
Okay, V-F-5-8-2-2-9... I'm pulling up your details now. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

Are you not listening? I told you, it's the wrong size! It's way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. I'm not interested in an exchange for another one of your products, I want my money back. Is that clear enough?
Yes, perfectly clear. I just need to confirm a few details. I see the jersey was delivered 48 days ago...

And? What's your point? Are you trying to find a reason to deny this? I swear, if you give me the runaround I'm going straight to social media and letting everyone know how you treat customers. Get me your manager, now!
There's no need for that, sir. I can resolve this for you. I was just confirming the date. Your item is well within our 90-day return window. I can approve this return for a full refund right now.
Oh. Well... why didn't you just say that? So you're approving it?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. I am sending an email to you as we speak with a pre-paid shipping label. Simply print it out, place the jersey back in a package, and drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll get a full refund.
Okay. A full refund, no questions asked? No restocking fees?
That's correct. No fees whatsoever. The email should be in your inbox now.
Alright, I see it. Fine. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
